The following events took place in '''365 BBY'''.

==Proem==
By this year, [[Hettitite]] and its population of [[near-Human]]s were threatened by a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]].<ref name="TEA" />

==The galaxy in 365 BBY==
In 365 BBY, near-Humans from Hettitite colonized [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]] to escape a supernova.<ref name="TEA" />

==Impact==
Over time, the population of Sernpidal grew to eight million, enough to make it the most populous [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Dalonbian sector/Legends|Dalonbian sector]]. This made it a target for the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] as they began their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Notable events==
*Sernpidal was colonized by near-Humans from Hettitite.<ref name="TEA" />
